Messages.LoadingContextsDescription: Reading Repository registrations, connection status, and migration metadata.
Messages.NoContextsDescription: Register a Repository DbContext to unlock database diagnostics.

Guide.Title: Manual Activity Query
Guide.UnsupportedDescription: Repository does not have a built-in activity SQL template for this EF Core provider yet. Use the provider's own session, process, or activity catalog views.
Guide.UsageDescription: Run this read-only SQL against the same database used by the selected DbContext when you want to inspect activity outside the dashboard.
Guide.SourceDescription: Repository reads provider activity from {0} and normalizes the rows for the dashboard.

Columns.ApplicationName: Application name reported by the client connection.
Columns.Waiting: Whether the session is waiting for a resource or lock.
Columns.Query: Current or most recent SQL text.
Columns.BackendStart: Time when the backend process started.
Columns.XactStart: Time when the current transaction started.
Columns.StateChange: Time when the session state last changed.

Migrations.DisabledInProduction: Migration updates are disabled in Production unless explicitly enabled in module options.

Lists.ExternalAppliedDescription: Rows found in the database history table but not in the selected migration assembly.

Messages.ChooseAvailable: The requested registration is unavailable. Choose an existing context to continue.

Workbench.ConfirmAll: Apply pending migrations across all {0} registered contexts? Each context is processed sequentially. A failure does not roll back changes already applied to other databases.
Workbench.ConfirmContext: Apply pending migrations to {0} in assembly {1}? This command targets this exact registration.

Options.ReadFailed: Repository options could not be captured
Options.NoMatches: No options match the current search and group.

Activity.ReadUnavailableDescription: The provider activity view could not be read. Consult the manual query guide for provider requirements.
Activity.DatabaseScopeDescription: These counts include other clients on this database. Waiting overlaps session states; these are not measurements of this application's connection pool.
Activity.LedgerDescription: Compare sessions across the full provider result. Open a session to inspect its complete captured evidence.
Activity.SearchPlaceholder: SQL, session ID, database, client, user, application, state or waiting
Activity.QueryAgeDescription: Query age is time since query_start. For an idle session, it is the age of the last query, not time spent executing.
Activity.NoRowsDescription: The provider query completed successfully and returned no visible sessions.
Activity.NoMatchesDescription: The snapshot still contains sessions. Clear the search to restore the full ledger.

Guide.ScopeDescription: This SQL returns the server-visible sessions exposed to the database login across databases, including other clients and the inspection session. SQL availability describes the built-in template, not the outcome of an activity query.
Guide.RuntimeDescription: Age since query_start, including the last query for an idle session. This is not always active execution time.
Guide.QueryStartDescription: Start time of the current or most recent query.

Inspector.Title: Database session details
Inspector.ScopeDescription: This is a server-visible session captured through the selected DbContext. It can belong to another database or client; the selected context establishes query provenance and does not establish ownership of the session or its connection pool.
Inspector.QueryDescription: The provider's current or most recent SQL text, preserved without preview truncation.
Inspector.NoQuery: The provider did not return query text for this session.
Inspector.RuntimeDescription: Age since query start is measured at capture. For idle sessions it can refer to the most recent query rather than active execution time.
Inspector.TimestampDescription: Provider timestamps are shown as received. Their original timezone offset may be unavailable; missing timestamps remain unavailable.

Activity.PostgreSqlWaitNote: PostgreSQL reports lock waits only. No lock wait does not exclude other wait categories.
Activity.PostgreSqlWaitDescription: True only when wait_event_type is Lock. False does not exclude other PostgreSQL wait categories.

Workbench.BulkOutcome: Migration command completed · {0} applied, {1} skipped, {2} failed

Persistence.ActivityCalm: {0} visible sessions include {1} on {2}. No session is waiting, idle in a transaction, or active for at least 30 s.
Persistence.ActivityProvenanceNote: Executes the read-only activity query through the selected DbContext's credentials. Selection establishes query provenance, not session or pool ownership.
Persistence.ActivityScopeFinding: {0} active sessions have a query age of at least 30 s. {1} visible sessions are outside {2}.
Persistence.ActivityStale: The last provider read failed. The activity sample captured at {0} is still displayed.
Persistence.ActivityUnsupported: Unsupported provider for built-in activity query
Persistence.AssemblyNote: States are scoped to migration assembly {0}.
Persistence.CommandScope: The command checks pending migrations again before applying them. Timeout per context: {0}.
Persistence.ConnectionsCalm: All {0} registered contexts passed their connection probes across {1} physical targets. No reads failed and no migrations are pending.
Persistence.FailedFinding: Migration or configuration evidence is incomplete for {0}.
Persistence.HostPolicyDescription: Captured from the host's singleton ModuleRepositoryOption and applied uniformly across registrations.
Persistence.IdleFinding: {0} ({1} total) is idle in an open transaction and may hold locks.
Persistence.IncompleteFact: Connection or migration evidence is incomplete for these contexts.
Persistence.KnownPendingFact: Includes the current assemblies of all registered contexts.
Persistence.LoadFailedBody: Could not read registered Repository DbContexts from the host. Refresh to retry once database access recovers.
Persistence.LockFinding: {0} is waiting for a lock ({1} lock waits in total).
Persistence.ManualTip: Connection probes, activity snapshots, and migration status are read on demand on refresh or context selection; no background polling loop runs.
Persistence.MigrationKeyboard: Use ↑↓ to traverse context tracks and Enter to load its assembly and history tables below.
Persistence.MigrationNoMatch: No migrations match the selected states and search.
Persistence.MigrationReadFailed: Migration status could not be loaded for this context
Persistence.MigrationsCalm: All {0} contexts are aligned with their current migration assemblies.
Persistence.MigrationTrackNote: Inspect every context's compiled migration chain before running single or fleet-wide updates. Select any track to inspect its identifiers and external history below.
Persistence.OpenTransactionNote: This session is idle inside a transaction. It can hold locks until its client commits, rolls back, or disconnects.
Persistence.OptionsDescription: Separates the five host-wide ModuleRepository flags from per-context settings so shared flags are stated once instead of paginated per context.
Persistence.OptionsRedirect: Consolidated the legacy Repository options route into this section; /repository-dashboard/options remains supported as a direct link.
Persistence.OutcomesNote: Actual per-context outcomes from the latest migration command in this session, detached from subsequent refreshes.
Persistence.Peers: Shares the same server as {0}; pg_stat_activity shows every session visible to this login.
Persistence.PgWaitFact: PostgreSQL reports lock waits only. This count overlaps session state.
Persistence.PoolHonesty: Pool ceilings come from parsed connection-string keywords or known provider defaults (Max 100 / Min 0); they do not measure live local pool occupancy.
Persistence.ProbeFact: Checks database access only. Host readiness is measured separately.
Persistence.RecheckUnreadable: History was unreadable at capture. This context will be checked again during the command.
Persistence.RegistryDescription: Compare connection probes, physical targets, pool ceilings, schema drift, and tracking configuration side by side.
Persistence.RegistryNoMatch: No contexts match the current filters.
Persistence.RegistrySearch: Search context, assembly, database, host, or provider…
Persistence.RevealNote: Sensitive keywords (password, pwd, secret, token, key, credential) stay masked until explicitly revealed.
Persistence.RulerDescription: Plots every server-visible session by state on a logarithmic query-age axis. Solid marks belong to the selected context's database; hollow marks belong to other databases on the same server.
Persistence.RulerKeyboard: ↑↓ switches lanes, ←→ moves across sessions, Enter opens full SQL and 15-field evidence.
Persistence.RulerTitle: Database scope breakdown & log-scaled query-age ruler
Persistence.SensitiveLoggingNote: Sensitive data logging defaults to enabled in Development (exposes SQL parameters); verify explicit false before Production.
Persistence.Sequential: Sequential execution · not a cross-database transaction
Persistence.SequentialNote: Each context runs MigrateAsync independently in registry order. A failure does not roll back changes already committed to earlier databases, and cancellation may interrupt observation after commit.
Persistence.SessionMissingNote: Refresh the selected context or choose a session still present in the ledger.
Persistence.SharedTargetCount: {0} targets are shared by multiple contexts.
Persistence.StaleBody: The most recent registry or detail capture did not succeed. Evidence captured at {0} remains visible without advancing capture time; check connectivity and refresh again.
Persistence.StaleTitle: Last refresh failed · showing retained snapshot
Persistence.TopologyDescription: Grouped by resolved DataSource and database to reveal shared databases, transaction participation, and declared pool limits.
Persistence.TopologyKeyboard: Use ↑↓ to move between contexts, Enter to open the Evidence Sheet; click a database header to filter the inventory.
Persistence.UnreadableFinding: History could not be read for {0}, so the fleet pending count is partial.
Persistence.WaitFact: Provider waiting state. This count overlaps session state.
Persistence.WaitFinding: {0} is waiting according to the provider ({1} waiting sessions in total).
